name: Symbolic Mastery (Item Mastery, Mythic)
body:
You can use your holy symbol to unleash bursts of divine energy.

Prerequisite(s): Symbolic Mastery.

Benefit(s): You can expend 2 daily uses of Symbolic Mastery to channel positive or negative energy, depending from your alignment and that of your deity. You channel energy as a cleric of a level equal to your number of ranks in Use Magic Device. If you wish, you can also choose a variant channeling ability based on your deity’s portfolio. You cannot apply feats that influence and modify the channel energy ability to this channeling effect.
